messages.content: Help me configure an `ObjectParser` instance named `searchHitParser` to parse the inner hits fields for a search result in an Elasticsearch application?

function.name: SearchHit_declareInnerHitsParseFields
function.description: Configures an ObjectParser to parse the inner hits fields of a search result. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

parser.description: The ObjectParser instance to configure. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.
